notes.title: Tower Defense Fest: Join the Adventure!
notes.content:
[h2]Aquest Demo Now Available – Join the Tower Defense Fest![/h2]

Dive into the world of Aquest, a unique tower defense game offering unparalleled freedom to build on an open map with enemies attacking from all directions. Strategize your defenses and prepare for relentless waves of foes. Face off against formidable bosses to earn valuable items that will aid you in subsequent waves.

This is an early access demo, and we're excited to bring you more features soon!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Update patch notes[/h1]

We are glad to announce the first update of Aquest since the demo was released! We've introduced new features such as a new terrain and a new mob. Additionally, various improvements have been made, and several bugs have been fixed.

[h2]New water terrain[/h2]

When constructing a new building, the tiles beneath it are transformed into water tiles, enhancing the visual appeal of the map and revitalizing the dried plants. Conversely, when buildings are destroyed, the terrain reverts to its dry state, causing the plants on those tiles to wither once more.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45094123/9c528faa2046e4769d3c94e67ef3a7386729c4fd.png[/img]

[h2]Adding Llama[/h2]

The llama is a new mob with a 15% chance of spawning when a new wave begins. To capture the llama, players must chase and catch it. Once caught, the llama drops a chest on the ground, offering the player a new item selection. Are you fast enough to catch it?

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45094123/06c002e61cd8da2a0d979038e3e7ff9d3f0dc13f.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Waves now start only after all enemies are defeated. However, if any enemies are still alive after X seconds, the next wave begins regardless.
[*] Adjustments have been made to tower prices, damage, and upgrade costs.
[*] Game difficulty has been increased by adding more enemies per wave and buffing some enemies.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bombs are no longer getting triggered when placed on the ground.
[*] Towers were not being upgraded even when the player used the anvil.
[*] Player items were not being reset after returning to the menu and selecting "Play".
[*] Fixed small issues.
[/list]

Stay tuned, because this is not the final update! We have plenty of new features prepared for the future!
